description: This file defines the MusicProvider class, a utility for fetching, parsing, and managing a catalog of music tracks from a server-side JSON source. It includes methods for retrieving tracks by genre, searching, updating metadata, and managing favorites. It is part of an Android media browsing service implementation.

classes.name: MusicProvider
classes.description: A utility class to supply media metadata for music tracks, supporting retrieval from a remote JSON source, categorization, search, and favorites management.

methods.name: getGenres
methods.description: Returns an iterable of available music genres if initialized; otherwise, an empty list.

methods.name: getMusicsByGenre
methods.description: Returns an iterable of MediaMetadata objects belonging to the specified genre if initialized.

methods.name: searchMusic
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search over track titles for the specified query.

methods.name: getMusic
methods.description: Retrieves the MediaMetadata of a track by its unique music ID.

methods.name: updateMusic
methods.description: Updates the metadata for a specific music ID and rebuilds genre lists if the genre changes.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Marks or unmarks a track as a favorite.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks whether a track is marked as favorite.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks whether the media catalog has been fully initialized.

methods.name: retrieveMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the media catalog from the server, updating internal state and invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: buildListsByGenre
methods.description: Rebuilds the genre-to-tracks mapping based on current track metadata.

methods.name: retrieveMedia
methods.description: Handles the core logic to fetch and parse the JSON media catalog from the server.

methods.name: buildFromJSON
methods.description: Constructs MediaMetadata objects from JSON data, normalizing URLs and creating unique IDs.

methods.name: fetchJSONFromUrl
methods.description: Performs network I/O to retrieve JSON data from a URL and returns a JSONObject.
